name: agentic-development-kit
description: Skill library (workflow orchestration + per-technology knowledge), a tiered subagent pipeline, quality-check hooks, and a bundled database MCP for AI-assisted software development. Technology-agnostic core; stack-specific knowledge lives in its own skills.

postgres_primary_host.title: PostgreSQL (primary) host
postgres_primary_host.description: Leave every field of a connection empty to skip it entirely - toolbox connects only to what's filled in.

postgres_primary_user.title: PostgreSQL (primary) user
postgres_primary_user.description: Must be a read-only (SELECT-only) DB role - see mcp/toolbox/README.md.

postgres_primary_password.title: PostgreSQL (primary) password
postgres_primary_password.description: Stored securely, never written to a plain settings file.

postgres_analytics_host.title: PostgreSQL (analytics) host
postgres_analytics_host.description: Leave every field of this connection empty to skip it entirely.

postgres_analytics_user.title: PostgreSQL (analytics) user
postgres_analytics_user.description: Must be a read-only (SELECT-only) DB role.

postgres_analytics_password.title: PostgreSQL (analytics) password
postgres_analytics_password.description: Stored securely, never written to a plain settings file.

mysql_host.title: MySQL host
mysql_host.description: Leave every field of this connection empty to skip it entirely.

mysql_user.title: MySQL user
mysql_user.description: Must be a read-only (SELECT-only) DB account.

mysql_password.title: MySQL password
mysql_password.description: Stored securely, never written to a plain settings file.

tidb_host.title: TiDB host
tidb_host.description: Leave every field of this connection empty to skip it entirely.

tidb_user.title: TiDB user
tidb_user.description: Must be a read-only (SELECT-only) DB account.

tidb_password.title: TiDB password
tidb_password.description: Stored securely, never written to a plain settings file.

redis_address.title: Redis address
redis_address.description: host:port. Leave empty to skip the Redis connection entirely.

redis_username.title: Redis username
redis_username.description: Leave empty if no auth is used.

redis_password.title: Redis password
redis_password.description: Leave empty if no auth is used. Stored securely, never written to a plain settings file.

mongodb_uri.title: MongoDB connection URI
mongodb_uri.description: Full connection string, e.g. mongodb://user:pass@host:27017. Leave empty to skip the MongoDB connection entirely.

mongodb_database.title: MongoDB database
mongodb_database.description: Default database used by the bundled mongodb_* tools.

mongodb_collection.title: MongoDB collection
mongodb_collection.description: Default collection used by the bundled mongodb_* tools.
